checklist.text: It builds (compiled in the workspace with the screenshot driver: no errors; screenshots of the card, a trait tooltip and an average tooltip checked)
Select a bird: the card shows only its 2-3 standout trait rows, shorter than before; Follow and Center still sit under "Fond of"
Hold Left Alt: all eleven rows appear and the card grows (hint reads ALL TRAITS); let go: it shrinks back. Nothing flickers or jumps
Hover a trait row: a panel under the card shows the name, flavor line, and what it changes with numbers
Hold Alt and hover an average row: the panel says "<Scale>: average" and a one-line note
Faint-hearted, Night Owl, Hearthbound tooltip lines read right
Renaming a bird still types normally; pressing Alt while typing does nothing odd
Tab panel's bird tracker still shows the raw trait numbers (untouched)

description: The bird card shows only the 2-3 traits that make the bird stand out; hold Left Alt for all eleven scales. Every row has a tooltip: the flavor line (or an "average" note for scales where the bird has no trait) plus lines generated from the trait's numbers (`Traits.EffectLines`, from `TraitEffects`, so they always match). Decided Nov 5: traits stay discrete (no per-scale numbers); numbers show in tooltips; a held key, not a button. Card height now follows the rows shown (`CardBaseHeight` + rows, `Hud.BirdCardHeight`). When TraitEffects gets a new number, add a line to `numberLines` or `switchLines` in `Traits.cs`. Session 45. Files: `Hud.cs`, `Traits.cs`, `GameEngine.cs` (version only).
title: 5.19 Bird card: standout traits and tooltips
